name: edge-cmf
description: CMF 100% Edge-natif — Astro SSR + Micro-Workers Hono/Drizzle/D1 (Cahier des charges v3)

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -k -n content,auth,gateway,front,admin -c blue,magenta,yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev:content" "npm run dev:auth" "wait-on -t 60000 tcp:8701 tcp:8702 && npm run dev:gateway" "wait-on -t 90000 tcp:8703 && npm run dev:front" "wait-on -t 90000 tcp:8703 && npm run dev:admin"
scripts.deploy:workers: npm run deploy -w @edge-cmf/content-worker && npm run deploy -w @edge-cmf/auth-worker && npm run deploy -w @edge-cmf/gateway-worker
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run db:migrate:local -w @edge-cmf/content-worker && npm run db:migrate:local -w @edge-cmf/auth-worker
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run db:migrate:remote -w @edge-cmf/content-worker && npm run db:migrate:remote -w @edge-cmf/auth-worker
